'''Arnecio Ulvaw'op''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He deserted the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] sometime during the war and joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Crimson Phoenix Squadron]] as a pilot under [[Major/Legends|major]] [[Eker]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].

==Equipment==
During his time at the [[Science Outpost]] on Dathomir, Ulvaw'op [[Clothing/Legends|wore]] an [[Color/Legends|orange colored]] Rebel Alliance [[shirt]]. The shirt was essentially a plain shirt, commonly worn by other beings, except that it was emblazoned with a [[red]] [[Alliance Starbird]]. He also wore [[black]] dress slacks and [[Color/Legends|gray]] standard [[Boot/Legends|boots]]. Completing his uniform was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Bandolier/Legends|bandolier]].
